headline: Corpay (CPAY) Launches Agent Card For Secure AI Powered Business Payments
summary: Corpay (NYSE:CPAY) has launched Agent Card, a virtual card solution for AI agents to execute secure business payments. The product is designed for uses such as supplier payments, advertising spend, and procurement inside AI driven workflows. Agent Card extends Corpay’s existing payment infrastructure into AI powered automation, with controls aimed at managing spend and risk. Corpay is known for corporate payment solutions that help businesses manage accounts payable, cross border payments,...
